description: Source code for generating TypeScript type definitions for Playwright, including classes, methods, and documentation parsing.

classes.name: TypesGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating TypeScript type definitions from documentation and source data, including handling overrides, comments, and class structures.

methods.name: generateTypes
methods.description: Generates TypeScript definitions based on documentation, overrides, and class structures.

methods.name: canIgnoreMissingName
methods.description: Determines if a missing symbol can be ignored based on ignore list.

methods.name: shouldGenerate
methods.description: Checks if a class or method should be generated based on doNotGenerate set.

methods.name: docClassForName
methods.description: Retrieves documentation class info for a given class name, considering overrides.

methods.name: objectDefinitionsToString
methods.description: Converts object definitions to TypeScript interface strings.

methods.name: nameForProperty
methods.description: Determines property name, adding '?' if optional.

methods.name: classToString
methods.description: Converts class description to TypeScript interface string.

methods.name: argNameForType
methods.description: Generates argument name based on type.

methods.name: hasUniqueEvents
methods.description: Checks if a class has events not inherited from parent.

methods.name: classBody
methods.description: Generates class body including methods and event handlers.

methods.name: hasOwnMethod
methods.description: Checks if class has its own method implementation.

methods.name: parentClass
methods.description: Retrieves parent class of a given class.

methods.name: writeComment
methods.description: Formats comment string into JSDoc style with links.

methods.name: memberJSDOC
methods.description: Generates JSDoc comment for a member.
